experience.title: Senior Design Researcher
bullets: Lead the research for M365 AI experiences across the People, Connectors, and Extensibility charters, supporting 12 PMs and 8 designers across 3 Core teams.

Define opportunity areas for frontier solutions before they have a product spec, and inform the design of AI solutions already in market. Ground evalsets and assertions in scenarios drawn from user research to measure how solutions perform against real-world use cases rather than a synthetic dataset.

Ran foundational research on the agent-builder experience, establishing that people arrive with a clear goal for what they want an agent to do but no clear specification for how it should work, and have no way to tell which of their instructions an agent actually follows — so they judge agents holistically against real scenarios rather than verifying instruction by instruction. Findings directly shaped the design of the agent-building experience.

Mentor 3 researchers in user research process and methodologies. Trained 8 designers and 12 PMs in research approaches, study design, moderation, and AI-powered research methods through office hours, enabling 36 studies run independently by PMs and designers.

Champion AI adoption in the research community — driving experimentation, sharing learnings, and building reusable AI-powered solutions that advance research practice at scale. AI can carry the mechanical weight of research, but the ground truth it is measured against has to come from real people.

Contributed 18 Claude Skills to the studio and org-wide toolkit, wired into frontier-space core teams through GitHub automation so they run on their own rather than on request — ideas, prototypes, and specs are checked against existing research as a matter of course, surfacing where research supports, challenges, or extends a given direction.

Architected an automated UX evaluation solution using MCPs — given a user job-to-be-done, the system traverses predefined journeys and interactions to detect bugs, surface friction points, and score the user job periodically. Runs against 7 user journeys and 1 design flow spanning Teams and Windows experiences, catching close to 40 verified craft bugs.

Ran the experiments that established synthetic users as unfit to replace real participants: synthetic responses hold up on logical or normative reasoning but diverge once a question turns on preference formed by lived experience. Developed approaches for effective AI integration in research methodologies on that basis.

experience.title: UX Researcher 2
bullets: Led the research initiatives within M365 Core — People area.

Developed and executed a comprehensive research strategy encompassing formative and summative studies, surfacing hidden user mental models, rediscovering the personas, and surfacing 12 core user jobs to inform the launch of the new People App in Teams, which served over 2 million daily active users within 2 weeks of launch.

Challenged a product direction that treated users' work and personal lives as a single conflated experience across Microsoft offerings. Cross-team synthesis with researchers across global M365 Core showed the boundary was far more nuanced than assumed, reframing “I want to access all my information across work and life together” to “I want to access my relevant/important information across work and life with a degree of separation”.
Partnered with fellow researchers across global M365 Core, amplifying our collective expertise and insights in the People domain to inform product development.
Fostered a stakeholder culture where research insights drove decision-making, resulting in more user-centered product development than the prior telemetry- and intuition-based approach.
Served as a core team member for an India-wide research learning initiative, organizing sessions and contributing through workshops, technique presentations, and case studies.

experience.title: Senior UX Researcher
bullets: Crafted research-driven design strategies to understand and tackle the right user issues, adapting Google's UX design sprint approach to the MathWorks way of working.

Collaborated with a UX team across geographies to improve cross-product workflows in MATLAB Coder and the Simulink Toolstrip, uncovering user jobs and surfacing user mental models across the Coder and Variant workflows.
Planned and moderated user studies across geographies involving non-English-speaking users, focusing on Japanese participants to reach a key geography in our customer pool.
Built research capability within the team by mentoring 2 researchers on core methodologies and practice — raising the floor on research quality and independence.

experience.title: UX Specialist
bullets: Captured user roles, goals, and requirements through contextual interviews with stakeholders and surveys covering product usage and demographics.
Identified pain points in existing workflows through journey mapping, CARD methodology, and secondary research.
Designed deliverables from wireframe sketches through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes, validating GUI and API designs through usability studies and PURE evaluations.
